people.name: Achzib
people.line: A coastal town allotted to Asher.

people.name: Ahlab
people.line: A Canaanite city allotted to Asher.

people.name: Ramah
people.line: A town on the border of Asher and Tyre

people.name: Tyre
people.line: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade

translations.web: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;
translations.bsb: The border then turned back toward Ramah as far as the fortified city of Tyre, turned toward Hosah, and came out at the Sea in the region of Achzib,
translations.kjv: And then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:
translations.asv: and the border turned to Ramah, and to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea by the region of Achzib;
